episode_observation.what_happened: The source-valid local Type-I blow-up passage reaches a nontrivial mild bounded ancient solution with local strong L3 velocity compactness and local weak L3/2 pressure compactness, but the selected critical-element and global-L3 rigidity methods require a separately supplied global critical topology/tightness condition.

diagnoses.statement: The compactness-stage output type is local, while the selected rigidity-stage input type is global; direct gluing is unlicensed without a new global tightness/state-space certificate.
Translation/dilation loss of compactness can preserve every fixed compact-set limit while critical mass escapes, so local convergence cannot serve as a proxy for global critical compactness.
Backward-uniqueness language does not discharge theorem-specific terminal/exterior/regularity hypotheses for the exact ancient limit.

scoped_failures.statement: Local strong convergence leaves translated/dilated profiles uncontrolled globally.
scoped_failures.scope_limit: Does not say a Navier-Stokes profile decomposition cannot control them after a global critical topology is supplied.

scoped_failures.statement: Local pressure/velocity compactness does not certify the global tail required by the selected global rigidity route.
scoped_failures.scope_limit: Does not refute dynamics-specific far-field estimates.

scoped_failures.statement: Finite I plus local suitable compactness is not the same data type as a backward global-L3 sequence or precompact global critical orbit.
scoped_failures.scope_limit: Missing implication is an open obligation, not proven impossible.

scoped_failures.statement: Backward uniqueness is blocked until the exact theorem hypotheses are bound to the ancient limit.
scoped_failures.scope_limit: Does not dispute the source theorem.

scoped_failures.statement: Stationary Leray-profile Liouville theorems cannot be transferred to arbitrary time-dependent ancient solutions without proving the self-similar reduction.
scoped_failures.scope_limit: Exact self-similar subclasses remain covered by their source theorems.

reusable_obstruction.statement: Before any minimal-critical-element or backward-global-L3 rigidity route, construct a source-valid global critical state/tightness certificate and verify pressure/far-field and symmetry compatibility.

lesson_proposal.statement: When a blow-up argument produces only local compactness, treat global critical tightness as a distinct gluing obligation rather than silently inheriting it from a rigidity theorem's input class.
